instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide, eye-level shot capturing a group walking in a park. The scene is set in an outdoor grassy park under bright daylight with lush green trees in the background. The woman in the red dress (R1) walks on the left, holding hands with a boy on her right and a girl on her left. Beside them, the girl in the pink shirt and red bucket hat (R2) walks hand-in-hand with the woman in the mustard cardigan (R3) in the center. The blonde girl in denim overalls and a red bucket hat (R4) walks on the right, holding hands with the woman in the mustard cardigan (R3). They all walk forward in a line. Three other children in red hats walk interspersed in the line holding hands. Bright natural daylight casts soft shadows, highlighting the warm tones of the park.
